scope: Compose authoritative claim, active-GM, and manifest-scoped receipt-ledger rereads into the M679 pre-dispatch context without exposing mutation or runtime execution.

implemented.readCapabilities: The preflight dependency surface exposes only claim-store load, current-GM read, and receipt-ledger enumerate; adapter, claim, receipt append, receipt write, and Foundry capabilities are excluded.
implemented.claimObservation: A successful claim load is wrapped as a fresh authoritative claim-store-load observation; missing, unavailable, unknown, available, malformed, or identity-invalid claims block before later reads.
implemented.gmObservation: The current-GM reader is wrapped as an execution-time active-GM reread and drift or reader failure blocks before ledger enumeration.
implemented.ledgerObservation: Ledger and query identities are derived from the exact manifest, permit, and claimed claim; the returned snapshot is validated with the M679 manifest coverage, hash, identity, and recovery rules.
implemented.pendingPersistence: Pending receipt persistence is derived only from the exact selected absent ledger operation and deterministic terminal receipt identity; caller-supplied persistence is not accepted.
implemented.preDispatch: The validated observations are passed to prepareStagedInversePreDispatchContext, preserving blocked/selected/complete outcomes and the non-execution safety literals.

validation.focused: 4 files / 16 tests passed across preflight orchestration, pre-dispatch, receipt-ledger, and executor-boundary contracts.
validation.fullGate: npm run check:full passed: workflow checker PASS (score 63; 10/16 gates), package and desktop builds passed, full Vitest passed 149 files / 760 tests, and tooling verification passed with no failures.
validation.databaseBeforeImplementation: M680 KB rebuild and read-only queries passed at 1101 sources / 941 facts / 808 decisions before implementation.
validation.workflowAfterImplementation: Active-slice checker PASS; Stage 11 proposal-approval-history remains the only active stage and readyClaim remains false.

delegation: A hidden Sol Medium read-only architecture audit independently recommended the load/read/enumerate-only surface, authoritative observation wrappers, derived pending identity, call-order tests, and the explicit exclusion of adapter/append/Foundry capabilities; the worker changed no files and was closed after receipt review.
selectedNext: M682 code-only claim-store post-write authoritative reread contract; keep adapter dispatch, receipt append, Foundry action, runtime mutation, and Stage 11 acceptance excluded.
